purpose: Production binding and state-transition contract that turns Philadelphia event-resolution rules into deterministic Gamecast animation selections while preserving the existing non-chibi fallback and team isolation.

bindingContract.teamIsolation: Reject any player binding whose canonical roster team is not PHI.

transitionPolicy.newPlay: Clear transient animation, signature, possession-transfer and impact state before selecting the first event for the new playKey.
transitionPolicy.samePlay: Blend only between actions belonging to the same canonical player unless the event explicitly transfers possession or identifies a second participant.
transitionPolicy.repeatedEvent: Do not restart an identical animation for the same player/event fingerprint while it is already active.
transitionPolicy.outOfOrderEvent: Ignore an event whose sequence/timestamp precedes accepted state for the current playKey unless marked as an authoritative correction.
transitionPolicy.authoritativeCorrection: Reset transient state for the corrected play and resolve again from the corrected event payload.
transitionPolicy.playEnd: Blend to player idle/base, release transient ball ownership, and return root motion to the locked bottom-center foot anchor.
transitionPolicy.gameChange: Destroy Philadelphia transient bindings before resolving a different game; never carry animation state across games.

possessionPolicy.visualRule: The football remains attached to the established possession hand/socket until an explicit transfer or release event; fallback must not duplicate or teleport the ball.

signaturePolicy.guard: No other player or event may receive a named signature unless a later source-verified signature manifest explicitly adds it.

renderInvariants.appearanceAuthority: current official Eagles headshot lock from the appearance-reference phase; never infer appearance from name
renderInvariants.camera: shared locked Dallas-approved three-quarter Gamecast angle
renderInvariants.lighting: shared Dallas-approved neutral stadium key/fill/rim rig
renderInvariants.scale: player-specific locked scale; no action-driven rescaling
renderInvariants.footAnchor: bottom-center between planted feet; airborne actions return to projected world anchor
renderInvariants.uniformNumber: roster.json current number; invariant across base/action/signature assets

fallbackPolicy.missingFile: Continue down fallback order without blanking the scene.
fallbackPolicy.unknownPlayer: Do not substitute a similarly named Philadelphia player; retain existing non-chibi Gamecast presentation.
fallbackPolicy.unknownEvent: Prefer idle/base only for a resolved Philadelphia player; otherwise retain existing non-chibi Gamecast presentation.
fallbackPolicy.openRosterSlot: The official snapshot has 52 active identities and one open slot; never synthesize a placeholder player.

checks: All animation selection remains filtered by roster.json action inventory.
Named signatures are limited to the four source-verified Philadelphia routes.
Signature football moves remain classified as moves rather than fabricated celebrations.
Repeated polling cannot continuously restart the same animation fingerprint.
New-play, game-change and authoritative-correction paths clear stale transient state.
Possession continuity survives action fallback without ball duplication.
Missing assets fail soft and never blank Gamecast.
Cross-team identity collisions cannot resolve into Philadelphia assets.
The open 53rd roster slot cannot create a synthetic identity.
No MLB or NHL renderer, selector, state path or asset is referenced or changed by this contract.
